parameters.query: INSERT INTO gitlab_projects (project_id, project_name, project_path, description, web_url, created_at, last_activity_at) VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, {{ $json.name }}, {{ $json.path }}, {{ $json.description }}, {{ $json.web_url }}, {{ $json.created_at }}, {{ $json.last_activity_at }}) ON CONFLICT (project_id) DO UPDATE SET project_name = EXCLUDED.project_name, last_activity_at = EXCLUDED.last_activity_at, collected_at = NOW()

=INSERT INTO gitlab_branches (project_id, branch_name, is_default, protected, last_commit_id, last_commit_date) VALUES ({{ $node["Get GitLab Projects"].json.id }}, {{ $json.name }}, {{ $json.default }}, {{ $json.protected }}, {{ $json.commit.id }}, {{ $json.commit.committed_date }}) ON CONFLICT (project_id, branch_name) DO UPDATE SET last_commit_id = EXCLUDED.last_commit_id, last_commit_date = EXCLUDED.last_commit_date, collected_at = NOW()

=INSERT INTO gitlab_commits (commit_id, project_id, branch_name, author_name, author_email, committer_name, committer_email, commit_title, commit_message, committed_date, authored_date, additions, deletions, total_changes) VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, {{ $node["Get GitLab Projects"].json.id }}, {{ $node["Get Branches"].json.name }}, {{ $json.author_name }}, {{ $json.author_email }}, {{ $json.committer_name }}, {{ $json.committer_email }}, {{ $json.title }}, {{ $json.message }}, {{ $json.committed_date }}, {{ $json.authored_date }}, {{ $json.stats.additions || 0 }}, {{ $json.stats.deletions || 0 }}, {{ ($json.stats.additions || 0) + ($json.stats.deletions || 0) }}) ON CONFLICT (commit_id) DO UPDATE SET collected_at = NOW()

=INSERT INTO gitlab_contributors (project_id, author_name, author_email, total_commits, total_additions, total_deletions, total_changes, first_commit_date, last_commit_date) SELECT project_id, author_name, author_email, COUNT(*) as total_commits, SUM(additions) as total_additions, SUM(deletions) as total_deletions, SUM(total_changes) as total_changes, MIN(committed_date) as first_commit_date, MAX(committed_date) as last_commit_date FROM gitlab_commits WHERE project_id = {{ $node["Get GitLab Projects"].json.id }} GROUP BY project_id, author_name, author_email ON CONFLICT (project_id, author_email) DO UPDATE SET total_commits = EXCLUDED.total_commits, total_additions = EXCLUDED.total_additions, total_deletions = EXCLUDED.total_deletions, total_changes = EXCLUDED.total_changes, last_commit_date = EXCLUDED.last_commit_date, collected_at = NOW()

=INSERT INTO gitlab_daily_stats (project_id, branch_name, author_email, stat_date, commits_count, additions, deletions, total_changes, estimated_hours) SELECT project_id, branch_name, author_email, DATE(committed_date) as stat_date, COUNT(*) as commits_count, SUM(additions) as additions, SUM(deletions) as deletions, SUM(total_changes) as total_changes, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 0.5, 2) as estimated_hours FROM gitlab_commits WHERE project_id = {{ $node["Get GitLab Projects"].json.id }} GROUP BY project_id, branch_name, author_email, DATE(committed_date) ON CONFLICT (project_id, branch_name, author_email, stat_date) DO UPDATE SET commits_count = EXCLUDED.commits_count, additions = EXCLUDED.additions, deletions = EXCLUDED.deletions, total_changes = EXCLUDED.total_changes, estimated_hours = EXCLUDED.estimated_hours, collected_at = NOW()
